description: Dials the number and the assistant handles the task on the phone. Business plan. The user's own phones stay quiet unless connect_user is true. Returns immediately with call_id. An empty transcript means speaking is still in progress. connect_user true asks the person to hold, rings the user's phones into the same conversation, and the assistant leaves.

connect_user.description: When true, the destination is asked to hold, the user's phones are rung into the same conversation, and the assistant leaves.

identity_id.description: Optional identity id. Omit it and Widely picks the caller ID the same way the app does. Needed only when the grant is limited to several numbers.

task.description: What the assistant should say and do. Max 500 characters.

name: request_speak
title: Call and speak
